source: MAFF / ADB, "ដំណាំសណ្តែកសៀង" [Soybean crop], official cultivation manual, 2005
text: Fertilizer recommendations cover basal and top-dress applications, with the manual noting soybean's biological nitrogen fixation via root-nodule rhizobia reduces (but does not eliminate) the crop's need for nitrogen fertilizer, and giving guidance on phosphorus and potassium rates appropriate to Cambodian upland soils.
